headline: Microsoft said in a regulatory filing that it signed more than $130 billion of new data center leases in the three months to 30 June 2026, taking its leases not yet started to $329.1 billion.
score_reason: Stale: the filing is from 29 Jul 2026 and the Yahoo Finance copy was only re-dated 13 Oct; lowered 2 from 7.
importance_line: It shows how much computing space Microsoft has locked in for years ahead, which matters to its investors and to power and land markets near data centers, but it is a quarter-old filing figure, not news from today.
summary: Bloomberg reports that this is Microsoft's biggest quarterly jump in data center leasing by far, with the company's investor relations chief calling it a sign of continued demand; the filing dates from 29 Jul 2026 and was re-posted on Yahoo Finance on 13 Oct 2026. The future payments do not yet show on Microsoft's balance sheet, and Bloomberg notes the company had been held back by too little data center capacity after pausing leasing for much of 2025.
notes: Read the Yahoo Finance copy of Bloomberg; original Bloomberg link found via Google News (dated 29 Jul 2026). Older news re-dated.
